statusDefinitions.pending: No durable item-level evidence recorded yet; may have been screened previously.
statusDefinitions.corrected: Text was revised in prior audit; status does not imply all claims independently verified.
statusDefinitions.uncertain: At least one claim or source detail requires further checking.
statusDefinitions.verified: Date and every material claim supported by at least one accessible source with evidenceStatus 'direct'; tertiary-only support is allowed but noted by sourceType.
statusDefinitions.revision_required: Evidence supports a change not yet committed.

notes: Initial migration: previous conversation citations without recoverable URLs are not treated as durable sources. Empty sources require backfill. Source links may support only part of a record. sourceFieldDefinitions.sourceType: primary (patent, statute, resolution, original record), official (agency or institution page), secondary (scholarly or press), tertiary (encyclopedia).
sourceFieldDefinitions.accessStatus: accessible | restricted (login, paywall or bot wall) | unreachable (network failure from the audit environment).
sourceFieldDefinitions.evidenceStatus: direct (states the date and the core claim) | partial (supports only part) | unconfirmed (not read).
sourceFieldDefinitions.provenance: direct_fetch (page read during the audit on accessCheckedAt) | prior_conversation_access_report (reported in an earlier chat, not re-read).
